name: binnacle-hud
description: A side panel with a Log the mod does not send to Claude, Memory lines the mod sends only after confirmation, and a preview of Watch. Absence from later model requests is unverified.

narrow.title: When there's no room for the side panel
narrow.description: The side panel needs fullscreen (/tui fullscreen) and a window 110 columns wide. hide: one line saying how to get it. strip: the full HUD above the prompt. /hud narrow hide|strip changes it.
